title: Keith House's roof ventilator moved to match two 1880s pictures
items: The cowl ventilator on 1808 Prairie's roof now stands 0.45 m behind the north wall's face instead of 0.6 m, closer to where the c. 1888 photograph looking south-west shows it.
The 1888 Glessner plate puts it a little further back, so it is built where it fits both pictures best: within a few pixels of each.
Its height and its place along the wall are unchanged.
